arxiv-2009-09139.title: Conditionally Adaptive Multi-Task Learning: Improving Transfer Learning in NLP Using Fewer Parameters & Less Data
arxiv-2009-09139.creator: Jonathan Pilault, Amine El hattami, Christopher Pal
arxiv-2009-09139.description: Abstract Multi-Task Learning (MTL) networks have emerged as a promising method for transferring learned knowledge across different tasks. However, MTL must deal with challenges such as: overfitting to low resource tasks, catastrophic forgetting, and negative task transfer, or learning interference. Often, in Natural Language Processing (NLP), a separate model per task is needed to obtain the best performance.

arxiv-2012-03083.title: Exploration-Exploitation in Multi-Agent Learning: Catastrophe Theory Meets Game Theory Thanks: Stefanos Leonardos gratefully acknowledgeS MOE AcRF Tier 2 Grant 2016-T2-1-170 and NRF 2018 Fellowship NRF-NRFF2018-07. Georgios Piliouras gratefully acknowledges MOE AcRF Tier 2 Grant 2016-T2-1-170, grant
arxiv-2012-03083.creator: Stefanos Leonardos, Georgios Piliouras
arxiv-2012-03083.description: Abstract Exploration-exploitation is a powerful and practical tool in multi-agent learning (MAL), however, its effects are far from understood. To make progress in this direction, we study a smooth analogue of Q-learning. We start by showing that our learning model has strong theoretical justification as an optimal model for studying exploration-exploitation.

arxiv-2105-05286.title: Edge coloring graphs with large minimum degree
arxiv-2105-05286.creator: Michael J. Plantholt, Songling Shan
arxiv-2105-05286.description: Abstract Abstract . Let G be a simple graph with maximum degree \Delta(G) . A subgraph H of G is overfull if |E(H)|>\Delta(G)\lfloor|V(H)|/2\rfloor . Chetwynd and Hilton in 1985 conjectured that a graph G with \Delta(G)>|V(G)|/3 has chromatic index \Delta(G) if and only if G contains no overfull subgraph.

arxiv-2201-02792.title: Defining maximum acceptable latency of AI-enhanced CAI tools
arxiv-2201-02792.creator: Claudio Fantinuoli, Maddalena Montecchio
arxiv-2201-02792.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Claudio Fantinuoli, Maddalena Montecchio. 1
Abstract

Recent years have seen an increasing number of studies around the design of computer-assisted interpreting tools with integrated automatic speech processing and their use by trainees and professional interpreters. This paper discusses the role of system latency of such tools and presents the results of an experiment designed to investigate the maximum system latency that is cognitively acceptable for interpreters working in the simultaneous modality.

arxiv-2207-12135.description: Abstract As different people perceive others’ emotional expressions differently, their annotation in terms of arousal and valence are per se subjective. To address this, these emotion annotations are typically collected by multiple annotators and averaged across annotators in order to obtain labels for arousal and valence.

arxiv-2305-08276.title: Response of the Verwey transition in magnetite to a controlled point-like disorder induced by 2.5 MeV electron irradiation
arxiv-2305-08276.creator: Ruslan Prozorov, Makariy A. Tanatar, Erik I. Timmons, Marcin Kończykowski, Tanya Prozorov
arxiv-2305-08276.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ruslan Prozorov, Makariy A. Tanatar, Erik I. Timmons, Marcin Kończykowski, Tanya Prozorov. A controlled point-like disorder induced by low temperature 2.5 MeV electron irradiation was used to probe the nature of the Verwey transition in magnetite, Fe 3 ​ O 4 \textnormal{Fe}_{3}\textnormal{O}_{4} . Two large single crystals, one with optimal transition temperature, T V ≈ 121 T_{V}\approx 121 K, and another with T V ≈ 109 T_{V}\approx 109 K, as well as biogenic nanocrystals, T V ≈ 110 T_{V}\approx 110 K, were examined.

arxiv-2308-04066.title: Smooth fields of Hilbert spaces, Hermitian bundles and Riemannian Direct Images
arxiv-2308-04066.creator: Harold Bustos
arxiv-2308-04066.description: Abstract Given a field of Hilbert spaces there are two ways to endow it with a smooth structure: the standard and geometrical notion of Hilbert (or Hermitian) bundle and the analytical notion of smooth field of Hilbert spaces. We study the relationship between these concepts in a general framework.

arxiv-2508-18784.title: Insights into User Interface Innovations from a Design Thinking Workshop at deRSE25
arxiv-2508-18784.creator: Maximilian Frank \autref 1 ∗ and Simon Lund \autref 2 ∗
arxiv-2508-18784.description: Abstract Large Language Models have become widely adopted tools due to their versatile capabilities, yet their user interfaces remain limited, often following rigid, linear interaction paradigms. In this paper, we present insights from a design thinking workshop held at the deRSE25 conference aiming at collaboratively developing innovative user interface concepts for LLMs.

pmc-13137355.creator: Jinhui Li, Yang Yu, Jiaxing Han
